title: Dave Ananth tax site — governed article records (src/data/articles.yaml)

category.comment: Drives the Student loans / IRD / Tax filters. Must match an entry in site.yaml `insights.filters` other than the leading "All" and the derived "In the media".

type.comment: Drives the "In the media" filter, which selects every record where type != "By Dave".

date.comment: A human display string, not a parsed date. It is rendered verbatim and is deliberately not constrained to a date format.

comment: JSON Schema `uniqueItems` only rejects wholly identical records. The stronger rule — `url` must be unique across the array, because the pre-Astro React list keyed on it and a duplicate would silently collapse two cards into one — is enforced by src/lib/content.ts and is part of this contract even though it is not expressible here.
